title: Spoke-to-Spoke Tunnel Not Forming
symptoms: All spokes can reach the hub's public IP
NHRP registrations succeed for all spokes
rootCause: The hub router is missing 'ip nhrp redirect' and the spokes are missing 'ip nhrp shortcut'. Without these commands, NHRP cannot resolve spoke-to-spoke paths, forcing all traffic through the hub (or dropping it entirely if routing demands direct paths).

steps.prompt: Which command shows the NHRP cache including spoke-to-spoke entries?
steps.hint: If only hub entries appear, spoke-to-spoke shortcuts aren't forming.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the tunnel interface configuration including NHRP options?
steps.hint: Look for 'ip nhrp redirect' on hub and 'ip nhrp shortcut' on spokes.

steps.prompt: Which command shows the DMVPN tunnel state and current peer count?
steps.hint: Look at the state - 'UP' with active NHRP entries confirms tunnels are healthy.
